content.text: In Zimbabwe, where PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-5|stripe]] are blocked, digital creators face a harsh reality: sell their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-2|How to]], courses, and templates without Stripe, or forgo 90% of their revenue to Gumroad's 10% fee. This is not a problem unique to Zimbabwe – in Pakistan, Bangladesh, and other countries, Stripe and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. The question is not 'how can I work around these restrictions?' but 'what infrastructure can I build that puts me in control of my digital commerce stack?' This post is a plain-language breakdown of the infrastructure you need to sell digital products without relying on Stripe or Gumroad.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Your digital commerce stack is the foundation of your business. It consists of tools that enable you to host, sell, and deliver digital products. When you use Stripe or Gumroad, you're not building a stack – you're renting a platform that charges you 10% on every sale. By building a sovereign stack, you own the infrastructure and can avoid these fees. This means more revenue for you and more control over your business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign stack consists of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. At the core is a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a fast and secure way to host your digital products. Next, you need a backend logic layer that enables automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-broken-here-infrastructure|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processing, order storage, and file delivery. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle this. Finally, you need a payment gateway that accepts cryptocurrencies like USDT and Bitcoin. NOWPayments is a leading provider of on-chain payment verification with a 0.5% fee – significantly lower than Gumroad's 10%.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. If you're based in countries where Stripe and Gumroad are unavailable or restricted, this is the solution you need. By building a sovereign stack, you can avoid platform fees and maintain control over your business. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to get started, including 6 blueprints and 7 templates. With this kit, you can deploy a sovereign stack in just a few hours and start selling your digital products without relying on Stripe or Gumroad.
By avoiding platform fees, you can retain up to 99% of your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A sovereign stack consists of the following components: a hosting platform, a backend logic layer, a payment gateway, and a file delivery system. Each component must work together seamlessly to enable automatic payment processing, order storage, and file delivery. With the right tools, you can build a stack that is faster, more secure, and more cost-effective than any platform-based solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign stack today, start by selecting the right tools for your business. Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic layer like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment gateway like NOWPayments. Next, configure your payment gateway to accept cryptocurrencies and set up automatic payment processing and order storage. Finally, test your stack to ensure that it works seamlessly and deploy it to your online store.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important thing to know is that building a sovereign stack requires technical expertise and infrastructure knowledge. However, with the right tools and guidance, anyone can build a stack that is faster, more secure, and more cost-effective than any platform-based solution. By avoiding platform fees and maintaining control over your business, you can retain more revenue and scale your business faster and more efficiently.
A sovereign stack is a digital commerce infrastructure that is faster, more secure, and more cost-effective than any platform-based solution.

If you're interested in learning more about building a sovereign stack, we recommend checking out our Complete Builder Kit ($197) – all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also visit our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our other offerings.
Your Deployment Checklist

To build a sovereign stack, start by selecting the right tools for your business, configure your payment gateway to accept cryptocurrencies, set up automatic payment processing and order storage, test your stack to ensure it works seamlessly, and deploy it to your online store. Additionally, ensure that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and demand as you scale your business.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a sovereign stack and why do I need it?

A sovereign stack is a digital commerce infrastructure that enables you to host, sell, and deliver digital products without relying on Stripe or Gumroad. By building a sovereign stack, you own the infrastructure and can avoid platform fees, retaining more revenue and maintaining control over your business.
How much does it cost to build a sovereign stack?

The cost of building a sovereign stack varies depending on the tools and services you choose. However, with the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can build a fully functional stack in just a few hours and start selling your digital products without relying on Stripe or Gumroad.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign stack?

The benefits of using a sovereign stack include avoiding platform fees, retaining more revenue, maintaining control over your business, scaling your business faster and more efficiently, and enjoying greater flexibility and customization options.
How do I integrate NOWPayments into my sovereign stack?

To integrate NOWPayments into your sovereign stack, configure your payment gateway to accept cryptocurrencies and set up automatic payment processing and order storage. You can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle this, and configure your payment gateway to fire a webhook when a payment is confirmed on-chain.
How do I test and deploy my sovereign stack?

To test and deploy your sovereign stack, start by setting up a development environment and testing your stack with a small group of users. Once you've tested and validated your stack, you can deploy it to your online store and start selling your digital products.
Can I sell digital products on my sovereign stack?
Yes, you can sell digital products on your sovereign stack. With the right tools and infrastructure in place, you can host, sell, and deliver digital products without relying on Stripe or Gumroad.
How do I scale my sovereign stack?

To scale your sovereign stack, ensure that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and demand. You can do this by upgrading your hosting platform, adding more servers to your backend logic layer, and configuring your payment gateway to handle increased transaction volume.
